Welcome to Voat Basil! Nice introduction. What are your favourite games on PS1/2?

I love Tekken 3, I spent so many hours playing that first at the local arcade, stretching my quarters out, playing until I had to pee. Then my dad bought us a PS1 and we got that game. I played it so much back when I was a child that I will always love it. Soul Caliber 2 since it was pretty much Tekken with weapons so I loved it too. In fact there was a crossover character, Heihachi Mishima from Tekken in Soul Caliber. My favourite one-player game is Crash Bandicoot Warped 3, Spyro is second,Sly Cooper is third, ApeEscape is fourth. Favourite racing game is Gran Turismo, my dad and I played that every weekend in my childhood. Favourite multi-player is CTR: Crash Team Racing, I like it better than MarioKart for sure.
